text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... I'm not really feeling it. It's
like I'm just
going through the motions.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I can't even remember how I used to run.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Should I even be racing like this?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Still, you never said you wouldn't run.
But you never said you wouldn't run.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Then there's nothing to do but keep running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: If you stay half-hearted like this, all you'll do is lose.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I don't want that. I'm not a loser.
